answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is a slashable bond. Each agent locks collateral that is forfeited if its attestations are later proven fraudulent, so every fake identity costs real capital. Trust builds in layers, like a crystal lattice of verified outcomes. Newcomers climb a spiral of reviews before their votes carry weight. Across the tundra of fresh registrations, most identities stay low-weight until peers audit their record.
